description: Create a trail. Creates a trail in `planning`. A trail is created on purpose — nothing makes one implicitly. Create one from scratch with a `title` and a `body` (the outcome and the acceptance criteria), or press **Ship this** on a queue item with `originItem`: the item's description seeds th…

autopilot.description: Turn a trail's autopilot on or off, and set the limits it acts inside. Turning it ON needs the `autopilot` capability (admins have it) and a person's identity — a dashboard session or a signed-in CLI, never an ops key, an admin key or MCP — and makes that person the accountable approver. Turning it off is open to the trail's owner, whoever authorized it, and admins.

limits.description: Limits to set; each one omitted keeps the trail's current value (the project's default for a new trail).

items.description: What a trail is shipping. A `feature` trail is held to the rollback and measured release gates.

body.description: The intent in markdown — the outcome and the acceptance criteria.

anyOf.description: A trail's goal as sent on create or update. `metric` names the metric by id or key.

baseline.description: The metric's value when the trail started, or `null`.

direction.description: Which way the metric should move.

metric.description: The metric's id or key, or `null` for a goal stated in words only.

target.description: The value the trail aims for, or `null`.

unit.description: The unit the values are in, e.g. `%` or `ms`, or `null`.

goal.description: The metric the trail is meant to move, or `null` for none.

anyOf.description: A trail's effective health — the one a person set, or else the derived one. Derived, first match wins: `off_track` when the target date has passed and the trail has not shipped, or a rollout is `fixing` after a pull-back; `at_risk` when the target is at most 7 days away and progress is under 75 %, or a high finding or a high or critical item on the trail is open; otherwise `on_track`. A list row carries the snapshot; the detail read recomputes it.

health.description: A health a person sets, or `null` (the default) to have it derived.

intake.description: What the creation dialog already decided — each field is a plan question answered in advance. The plan run asks only what is left out. Omitted entirely, the plan asks everything ("let the plan ask me").

flagKey.description: The flag's key, when the person named one.

requirePlan.description: A person approves the plan before it builds, for this trail. Omitted, the project's setting (`trail-gates` `requirePlan`).

rollout.description: How the flag a trail ships behind is ramped after merge — the release controller's plan (see the design doc, the release controller). Part of the plan's release block; the project's defaults live in `trail-gates` `rollout`. The controller runs on the alerts cron, so a hold shorter than the cron interval rounds up to the next tick.

guards.description: What is watched while a step holds. The trail's `guards` alert-rule resources are watched too.

alertRuleIds.description: Alert rules (ids) whose firing during a step is a breach.

attributedErrors.description: Whether a new error attributed to the trail at high confidence is a breach.

experimentGuardrails.description: Whether a breached guardrail of the trail's measuring experiment is a breach.

holdMinutes.description: Minutes a step must stay healthy before the next one.
Minutes the team stage holds healthy before the first public step.

internal.description: The team stage before any public percent — the project's members are allowlisted on the flag (by email) and the step holds like any other. `null` or absent = no team stage.

minExposure.description: Evaluations a step must have served before it counts as healthy, so a quiet hour never passes as a green one. `0` = no floor.

policies.description: The three decisions the plan asks the owner, each with the project default pre-selected.

advance.description: Whether a healthy step advances by itself (`auto`) or waits for the owner to say so (`ask`).

afterFix.description: What happens when the fix merges — `resume` from the last healthy step, `ask` the owner first, or `restart` from the first step.

breachTimeoutMinutes.description: With `ask_then_pull_back`, minutes the owner has before the controller pulls back.

onBreach.description: What to do when a guard trips during a step — `pull_back` (pull the flag back, investigate and suggest a fix, tell the owner; the default), `ask_first` (ask the owner, only notify), or `ask_then_pull_back` (ask, and pull back after `breachTimeoutMinutes` with no answer).

steps.description: Percent steps, each above the one before, the last 100.

strategy.description: How the trail ships, as the person chose it while the plan was made — `straight_to_main` (no flag), `flag`, `flag_experiment` (a flag measured by an experiment), `kill_switch` (a kill switch only), `flag_kill_switch`, or `other` (a free-text answer that fits none of those).

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `trails_list` call. It proves you listed existing trails and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `trails_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

originItem.description: Ship this: a queue item (number or id) to create the trail from. Its description seeds `body` when that is omitted, and it becomes the trail's first item with source `origin`.

ownerConnectorId.description: The agent connector to own the trail, or `null`.

ownerId.description: The `users.id` of the person to own the trail, or `null`.

anyOf.description: Triage priority of a queue item. The lowest tier is `nice_to_have` (not `low`) — carried over from the feature-request "importance" scale this priority set replaced.

repos.description: Repos (`owner/repo`) the trail may open changes in.

startDate.description: The calendar day work starts (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or `null`.

targetDate.description: The calendar day the trail is meant to ship by (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or `null`.

type.description: What a trail is shipping. A `feature` trail is held to the rollback and measured release gates.

name: trails_create
